rightsize: After the tests pass, measures the real diff and drops ceremony a tiny change never needed.
drift_reverify_skip: Skips re-checking a memory entry that was already verified this session.
checker_fanout: Runs the spec checkers side by side instead of one after another.
durable_plan: Keeps the plan on disk, so a workflow survives losing its session.
code_review: Reviews the diff along several lines at once: security, simplicity, structure.
design_judge: Scores design options against each other before one is picked.
sprint_mode: Lets the coordination channel hand tasks to helper sessions.
power_mode: Runs a batch of already-specified tickets through the mechanical phases once.
org_mode: Opens the pod of peer sessions behind the org track.
notifier: Tells you when a run stops and needs you.
mutation_oracle: Mutates your source to find out whether the tests would have caught it.
ac_conformance: Checks each acceptance criterion against the test that claims to cover it.
work_planner: Weighs the work a workflow carries against what the workflow itself costs, and offers you more to batch in when the balance is poor.
